reserveReview.rationale: The September 29 review used a partial on-chain observation and issuer descriptions of the ULTRA/FILQ basket. Re-fetched at Ethereum block 26083836 on 2026-10-01, the thBILL vault's tULTRA balance is 35,645,094.648059 while tULTRA totalSupply is 35,645,094.648069; the prior claim that the balance equaled the entire supply was inaccurate. Theo's current documentation identifies Wellington ULTRA and Fidelity FILQ, states that Theo manages a variable allocation between them, and discloses FILQ's asset-backed commercial paper exposure. Current product documentation says minting is instant and redemption is T+1 in USDC or USDT, with no holder claim on underlying fund units or securities. The reviewed pages do not give current complete basket weights or a dated thBILL assets-to-liabilities reconciliation; observing tULTRA alone does not supply those missing facts.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer descriptions establish an ULTRA/FILQ strategy basket; pinned tULTRA reads observe a wrapper position only and do not establish complete assets, current allocation weights, or matching liabilities.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current ULTRA/FILQ allocation weights, cash or in-flight balances, wrapper-to-fund backing and whole-basket liabilities remain unquantified. The 100% opaque modeled slice is not a measured 100% allocation to fully reconciled fund units.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Theo's fund fact sheets identify Standard Chartered Bank as ULTRA custodian and J.P. Morgan as FILQ custodian and administrator, with Sygnum providing FILQ tokenization. Provider allocation shares, thBILL-level segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, and rehypothecation safeguards are not established by those fact sheets. Theo's current mint-and-redeem documentation explicitly states that thBILL holders have no claim on underlying fund units or securities.
